column1: # ONE declarative table of every cleanup category. The analyzer, planner,
# executor, reporter, event emitter and UI all read it through lib/registry.sh;
# nothing else may keep a category list (audit finding F17).
# Format: tab-separated, '#' lines are comments, '-' means empty. The first
# non-comment line is the header and must name the 16 columns below, in order.
#   id          category id: [a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,30}; the only valid event 'group'
#   section     v3 --category value: trash user-caches logs system dev
#               (analyzed only in a full scan, never acted on)
#   undo        quarantine (restorable) | none (permanent, or a native tool)
#   analyzer    the analyze_* function that measures the category
#   roots       ':'-separated absolute or ~/-relative paths a remove op of this
#               category may lie under; 'X/*' = strictly below X, never X itself.
#               For native/report rows the roots are the default target or
#   native_cmd  allowlisted command of a native row (its first word is 'tool')
#   tool        executable a native row needs (must be installed)
#   in_use      cache_owner_running key checked before touching the category
#   unattended  yes only for tier=regenerable, action=remove, undo=quarantine
#   from_file   yes when 'apply --from-plan' may execute ops of this category
#   label_key   i18n key of the display name: cat_<id with - as _>
#   explain_key i18n key of the explanation: explain_<id with - as _>
#   order       unique integer; rows stay in ascending order (UI and consent
#               order); the table follows the v4 architecture contract, 3.3
# Old (v3.0.7 CATEGORY_REGISTRY ledger key) -> new category id. One line per
# v3 key; lib/registry.sh ignores them, tests/test_registry.sh parses them and
# the docs writer lifts them into MIGRATING_FROM_V3 and the changelog.
# rename: app-caches -> app-caches,app-caches-review    (split: allowlisted half / other half)
# rename: brew-stale -> brew                            (merged: one brew cleanup, estimate = max)
# rename: mail-total -> (dropped)                       (a sum of mail-data and the mail container)
# The v3 section names (--category) are unchanged.
